BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.

2. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.

3. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Run with the tool

5. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Material Schedules.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.

8. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Waste Water Disposal.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Waste Water Disposal.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Waste Water Disposal.

9. When learning Pre-cast Concrete Products, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-cast Concrete Products.

10. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

11. When learning Ceilings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Ceilings.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ceilings.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ceilings.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceilings.

12. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wall Finishes.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Wall Finishes.

13. When learning Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Skip safety briefings for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

14. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

15. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

16. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Building Drawing.
